reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: ceria-zirconia supports are well-known to enhance PGM dispersion and provide oxygen storage capacity, which directly addresses sintering and redox activity in automotive exhaust catalysts.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion based on a quantitative performance improvement and Pt sintering, though the 15-20% threshold is somewhat arbitrary.
reasons.usefulness: This is a highly useful hypothesis for the field, directly targeting a major industrial challenge (PGM thrifting) with a well-established materials strategy and a practical experimental design.
